text:
kai: noticed after the v2 flip some short-lived clients get pinned back to v1 for a few requests -> quota noise.
sophie: root cause looks like token-hash collisions in our quick sticky map when requests arrive concurrently. pins are 5m by default.
rahul: proposal: emit `route.pin_reason` with values `missing_header|token-race|handshake` so telemetry can separate token-race noise. add `route.pin_ttl_s`.
console-ui: we'll add a small column `pin_ratio(token-race)` and make the tooltip actionable. do we also want an API to clear pins per-tenant?
kai: yes. and add a short-lived suppression: if `pin_reason==token-race` and `flip_age_s < 3600` then suppress quota alert weighting.
telemetry: agreed. schema example (attrs): ["route.policy=prefer-v2","route.selected=v1","route.pin_reason=token-race","route.pin_ttl_s=300","rollout_cohort=flip-2025-07-20","alert.exempt=pin_transient"]
deploy-bot: flip: v2-default canary 5% - 2025-07-20 15:10 UTC
sophie: devops will lower the default pin ttl to 60s for canary to reduce ripple. monitor `distinct_token_pin_rate`.
rahul: I'll add aggregator rule to route that class into a transient bucket and emit `pin_transient_sample` to s3 for debugging.
console-ui: will prototype the UI widget in staging. return format for hint: {"hint_note":"token-race pins suppressed from quota alerts","hint_expires_at":"2025-07-20T16:10:00Z"}.
kai: great. if staging green, bump canary to 20% and watch `pin_ratio` and billing-alert-rate. report back here.
